notes: Folded into .3: the Vec::contains nested-loop dedup was replaced wholesale by a HashMap<Id, Outcome> approach in the same edit. Per-call complexity is now O(total ids across relevant entries) with O(1) lookups, vs. the previous O(n*m) where m = current dedup-set size.
title: get_changes dedup uses Vec::contains in nested loop — O(n*m) per call
